messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 3: we saw feature flag rollouts triggering cascade failures in downstream services (cache invalidation + dependency fan-out). Need dependency-aware rollout rules so one flag doesn't take multiple services down. Owners + small deliverables by next Wed?

tom: Agreed. Pattern: a flag enabled -> extra DB reads -> downstream cache stampede. We need per-dependency exposure caps and automatic scoped rollback (target only the cohort hitting the dependency), not a global kill.

mona: Two practical pieces: (1) dependency tags on flags (e.g., @db-heavy, @cache-write) so controller can apply stricter caps/longer hold windows; (2) a scoped-rollback mode that reduces exposure against the dependency key (region/service) rather than global percent.

elaine: Example: payments_v2 has tag @cache-write + @db-heavy. Controller should limit initial exposure to 5% for any flag with @cache-write and require a successful canary that includes dependent-service health checks.

zack: Implementation note: controller must evaluate metrics at the dependency dimension (service_id) and be able to map a user cohort -> impacted downstream services. That's non-trivial but doable if we enrich traces with feature_flag metadata.

mona: Draft config snippet for discussion:

```
flag: payments_v2
tags: [cache-write, db-heavy]
staged_ramp_pct: [1,5,20]
min_stage_minutes: 30
dependency_controls:
  max_exposure_per_dependency_pct: 5
  require_dependency_canary: true
  dependencies: [orders-service, cache-layer]
scoped_rollback: true
cohort_eval: true
```

Tom: Nice. For scoped rollback semantics: when dependency signal trips, reduce exposure only for traffic routed to that dependency (e.g., region us-east-1 or service instance group), not global. Also mark flag state as "degraded" and require manual re-ramp with SRE signoff.

sre-bot: INC-2025-043: added dependency-aware rollout follow-ups [mona, tom, zack]. Linked postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2025-043

mona: Action items (short):
- mona: add tag parsing + dependency controls to rollout schema + unit tests (owner: mona, ETA: 2025-11-04)
- zack: prototype trace enrichment for mapping flag -> downstream service + a script to generate dependency maps (owner: zack, ETA: 2025-10-30)
- tom: implement scoped_rollback logic in controller + simulation endpoint so reviewers can run historical windows (owner: tom, ETA: 2025-11-06)

elaine: Also add a "soft-fence" mode: if dependency health degrades but rollback would cause UX regression, controller can reduce exposure to a safe floor (e.g., 1%) and throttle new sessions to avoid cascading auth storms.

zack: I'll also add a dashboard template showing per-dependency exposure and a "who touched this dependency" audit panel.

mona: I'll open a draft PR with schema changes and a minimal simulator. Please test against last month's incidents.

elaine: Thanks all  let's sync next Tue 9am to demo the simulator and pick conservative defaults for dependency tags.
